items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Big Joe, you know this what you call them, that run the place, he said, how don't you have an amplifier? I said, yes sir.

ctx.x: Yeah. So uh. Big Joe, you know this what you call them, that run the place, he said, how don't you have an amplifier? I said, yes sir. He said, bring it. I said, well they told me not to bring it. He said, this is my place, bring it. So after I started bringing it, at the time she'd go stay one in two hours, you understand, or out on Connell Street, you know. Miss Kimmel? Yeah. She didn't like it. No it wasn't that. She was glad to get a relief. See it was similar to a jitney job. You know during that time we…

Didn't you have a list of questions about that? Yeah, I wanted to ask you some more about other people named Lewis, you know. Who, George Lewis? Yeah, are you akin to anybody else named Lewis? I just-
